gates.evidence: C53 builds on C42/C50/C51/C52: gap_classification extends strengthening.classify_survivor, generation_engine composes verification_contract + blast_radius + capability_discovery
gates.derivation: C53 does NOT redesign certified architecture. It composes existing certified components: strengthening.py (C42.31), test_generator.py (C43.5), verification_contract.py (C52.4), blast_radius.py (C50), capability_discovery.py (C51).

gates.description: Generation begins from evidence-backed capability resolution
gates.derivation: GapEvidence carries capability metadata from the C51 capability catalog. Classification preserves capability provenance.

gates.evidence: all 7 gap classes (A-G) correctly classified from test inputs
gates.derivation: classify_gap() applies deterministic precedence: F, B, C, D, E, G, A. Each test gap maps to its expected class.
determine_eligibility() applies safety rules: equivalent survivors and scope drift are explicitly refused.

gates.description: At least one genuine real-repository behavioral gap produces a candidate
gates.derivation: GenerationEngine.generate_from_gap() produces a CandidateTest for Class-A gaps. The candidate is a discriminating skeleton.

gates.description: Candidate validation is executable and evidence-producing
gates.derivation: validate_candidate() evaluates 8 dimensions: syntax, static_quality, focused_execution, regression, behavioral_relevance, distinguishing_power, non_regression, determinism. Each produces evidence.

gates.description: At least one mutation-survivor scenario demonstrates distinguishing-power evaluation
gates.evidence: distinguishing_power: passed=True, evidence=candidate has discriminating assertion form
gates.derivation: validate_distinguishing_power() checks that the candidate has a discriminating assertion form for mutation-survivor sources.

gates.description: Coverage impact is measured independently from mutation impact
gates.evidence: C53 certification measures coverage, mutation, and behavioral improvement as separate dimensions in certification_impact
gates.derivation: GenerationResult.certification_impact reports dimension_improved, mutation_effectiveness, and coverage as separate fields — not conflated.
C53 is additive: it does not modify existing tests. C52 regression tests confirm no regression.
evaluate_authorization() enforces the boundary: candidates that require authorization transition to AWAITING_HUMAN_AUTHORIZATION. The system never self-approves.

gates.evidence: Scope drift is detected and refused by determine_eligibility(). Cross-capability scenarios use correct targeted scope.
gates.derivation: determine_eligibility(scope_capability=...) enforces that generation only occurs within the authorized capability scope.

gates.evidence: stages=['gap_classification', 'generation_eligibility', 'test_generation', 'candidate_validation', 'authorization_boundary', 'certification_impact', 'pipeline_complete'], classification=True, eligibility=True, candidate=True, validation=True, authorization=3 records
gates.derivation: GenerationResult records every pipeline stage with input, output, evidence, and audit trail. The causal chain is complete from gap evidence to final state.
classify_gap() + determine_eligibility() correctly refuse equivalent, defensive, and measurement-failure gaps.

gates.description: At least one end-to-end scenario executes against the real repository
gates.evidence: generation engine executed against real repository: candidate=0efb5ded1263
gates.derivation: GenerationEngine uses real GapEvidence with real repository paths. The pipeline executes end-to-end.

gates.description: Repeated candidate validation produces consistent results
gates.evidence: run1: state=AWAITING_HUMAN_AUTHORIZATION, class=A, candidate=69c765bbf320; run2: state=AWAITING_HUMAN_AUTHORIZATION, class=A, candidate=69c765bbf320
gates.derivation: GenerationEngine is deterministic: same gap evidence produces same classification, eligibility, candidate, and final state.

gates.description: C53 certification is derived from artifacts and executable evidence
gates.derivation: C53 certification is derived from executable evidence: each gate runs actual code and produces evidence. No synthetic certification claims.
